'''Harc Seff''' was a [[Ishi Tib]] who was present in the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]'s [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] in [[4 ABY]]. Seff witnessed a performance by the [[Max Rebo Band]] and applauded when they finished their [[Jedi Rocks|song]]. The Ishi Tib was then present when [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] arrived disguised as the [[bounty hunter]] [[Boushh]] looking to claim the [[bounty]] on the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]].

==Biography==
[[File:Max_Rebo_Band_applause.png|thumb|left|250px|Harc Seff applauded the Max Rebo Band at Jabba's palace.]]
The [[Ishi Tib]] Harc Seff<ref name="Topps" /> spent time in the [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]]<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> of the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]<ref name="Absolutely Everything">''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''</ref> on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]<ref name="ROTJ" /> in the [[Standard year|year]] [[4 ABY]].<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' establishes that the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], including Seff's appearance, take place in [[4 ABY]].</ref> While in the palace, Seff viewed a performance of the song<ref name="ROTJ" /> "[[Jedi Rocks]]" by the [[Max Rebo Band]]<ref name="Absolutely Everything" /> in the Hutt's courtroom and applauded when the band finished. Jabba then called for a repeat of the song, but during the second performance the Hutt dropped the [[Slavery|slave]] [[Oola]] into the pit containing his pet [[rancor]]<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[Pateesa]]<ref name="Lifedebt">''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]''</ref> underneath the throne room.<ref name="ROTJ" />

After the performance [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] arrived in the throne room disguised as the [[bounty hunter]] [[Boushh]] in order to claim the [[bounty]] on the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]]. While Jabba and Organa haggled over the price of the bounty, Seff stood in front of the bounty hunter [[Boba Fett]] and the dancers [[Rystáll Sant]] and [[Lyn Me]]. Organa then shocked those present in the courtroom by activating a [[thermal detonator]] in order to threaten Jabba into paying more. The ploy amused Jabba and he agreed to pay more, satisfying Organa and causing her to de-activate the detonator. Organa and her allies [[Rescue of Han Solo|later]] [[Death|killed]] Jabba above the [[Great Pit of Carkoon|Pit of Carkoon]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Personality and traits==
Harc Seff had [[Color|green]] skin and yellow [[eye]]s.<ref name="Topps" />

==Equipment==
Harc Seff wore a blue [[Clothing|tunic]] over a white shirt while at Jabba's palace.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Harc_Seff_dancers.jpg||thumb|right|150px|The extra playing Harc Seff on the set of the Special Edition reshoots]]
Harc Seff first appeared in the [[1997]] [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|special edition re-release]] of the film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], in which the character was portrayed by an uncredited extra.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Seff went unnamed until the character appeared on a card in the [[Special Edition Limited]] set of [[Decipher]]'s ''[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]'' released in [[1998]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Harc Seff}}</ref>
